descriptions.s9_update_render_clock_8015caec: Lazily initializes update labels, advances the clock unless the context is paused, forwards the delta to the child and updates the renderer with the clock address.
descriptions.s9_construct_resource_owner_8017917c: Constructs the base, installs the vtable, counts instances, and acquires and initializes the shared resource for the first owner.
descriptions.s9_construct_shared_node_8017990c: Constructs the base and embedded members, lazily acquires a shared interface, increments the owner count and enables the instance.
descriptions.s9_ensure_resource_8017b6dc: Lazily replaces an empty held interface with the named resource and sets two bytes from manager virtual getters.
